authority_boundary: The pipeline only orchestrates deterministic pre-screening components over reviewed case records. It does not approve or reject a transaction, provide legal advice, clear sanctions or AML obligations, determine bank credit or K-SURE acceptance, quote executable terms, or infer missing inputs.
limitations: Version 1 accepts exactly one approved transaction in a case so that case-wide document and product refresh operations cannot overwrite records belonging to another transaction.
Country, counterparty, compliance, reviewed document, financial statement, FX, and explicit protection inputs must already be attached to the case or remain reported as missing.
A completed pipeline run means the deterministic stages executed or were explicitly skipped; it does not mean the transaction is complete, safe, eligible, or approved.
